system.description:
Pick one. Hero's Resolve: +1 Talent Die on Heart Checks with good NPCs or allies; -1 Skill Die when disguising yourself or on Heart Checks against enemies or NPCs aligned against your cause. Monster Hunter: +1 Talent Die on Strikes against non-human enemies; -1 Skill Die on Strikes against humans.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.75

automation.note: Choose Hero's Resolve or Monster Hunter when you take this, then delete the other option's two rules (or ignore their boxes).
